text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 44 units of metoclopramide hydrochloride 15 mg/0.07 mL, 9.8 mL at 8.9 units per day, providing 4.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 256 units at 8.8 units per day, providing 29.1 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show metoclopramide hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The product label identifies five registered plants: ACM Pharma (FEI 3004177283) in France, COSMA S.p.A. (FEI 3002806754) in Italy, Intertek (FEI 3002807539) in the United Kingdom, Patheon France SAS (FEI 3004468553) in France, and SGS France (FEI 3002807507) in France. All five plants have most recent FDA inspections classified VAI, with known dates ranging from 2022-09-15 to 2024-04-23.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The issue is localized distribution imbalance between campuses.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 82 units of 15 mg/0.07 mL, 9.8 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request approval.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
